description: Convert an image to PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF or TIFF. Reads JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF/HEIF, GIF (first frame), TIFF, SVG, BMP and ICO. Transparent areas are filled with `background` when writing JPEG (or always with `flatten`). EXIF rotation is applied. SVGs are rasterised at their own size (width/height or viewBox; 1024×1024 if neither), scripts never run. Images larger than 16384 px a side or 100 MP are scaled down to fit. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/image-convert/

background.description: Colour used for transparent areas when writing JPEG or when flatten is on. Default #ffffff.

flatten.description: Fill transparency with the background for every format, not only JPEG.

format.description: Output format. Default png (as on the website).

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for JPEG / WebP / AVIF (ignored for PNG). Default 92, same as the website.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: image_convert
title: Convert image format
